premise: A gust sends Pinecone rolling down the hill; Woodpecker calls the alarm and Hedgehog chases her the only fast way he knows: rolling.
inspiration: The Gingerbread Man (folk), turned: the runaway doesn't mind being caught, and the chase ends in a giggling heap.
lesson: Friends find their own way to help.

en-US.title: Pinecone Rolls Away
en-US.text: Pinecone {pinecone:pulse} was sitting at the top of the hill when… {canvas:wind 0.7 6s} a gust! {pinecone:spin} She started to roll. {pinecone:face surprised} [excited] Whoa! Roll, roll, roll, down the hill she went. {sfx:roll} Bumpity, bumpity, bump! {woodpecker:face surprised} [rushed] Look out! called Woodpecker {woodpecker:hop}. He tapped on every tree as he flew past: tap-tap, look out, tap-tap! Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} saw her coming. He couldn't run very fast. But he could do something else. [giggles] He tucked in his nose, curled up tight, {hedgehog:spin x3} and rolled after her! Roly-poly, roly-poly… {sfx:bump} Bump! They met at the bottom, in a soft pile of moss. {pinecone:face happy} {hedgehog:face happy} [laughs] Pinecone and Hedgehog lay there, dizzy and {pinecone:wobble} {hedgehog:wobble} giggling. Woodpecker {woodpecker:wobble} landed beside them. [happily] Race you up again? said Pinecone. {pinecone:hearts} {hedgehog:hearts}

es-ES.title: Piña se va rodando
es-ES.text: Piña {pinecone:pulse} estaba en lo alto de la colina cuando… {canvas:wind 0.7 6s} ¡una ráfaga! {pinecone:spin} Empezó a rodar. {pinecone:face surprised} [excited] ¡Uuuy! Rueda, rueda, rueda, colina abajo. {sfx:roll} ¡Bum, badabum, bum! {woodpecker:face surprised} [rushed] ¡Cuidado!, gritó el pájaro carpintero {woodpecker:hop}. Iba dando golpecitos en cada árbol al pasar: toc-toc, ¡cuidado!, toc-toc. Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} la vio llegar. No podía correr muy deprisa. Pero sabía hacer otra cosa. [giggles] Escondió la nariz, se hizo una bola, {hedgehog:spin x3} ¡y salió rodando detrás de ella! Rueda que rueda, rueda que rueda… {sfx:bump} ¡Pum! Se juntaron abajo del todo, en un montón de musgo blandito. {pinecone:face happy} {hedgehog:face happy} [laughs] Piña y Erizo se quedaron allí, mareados y {pinecone:wobble} {hedgehog:wobble} riéndose sin parar. El carpintero {woodpecker:wobble} se posó a su lado. [happily] ¿Otra carrera hasta arriba?, dijo Piña. {pinecone:hearts} {hedgehog:hearts}

roll.prompt: a pinecone bouncing and rolling down a grassy hill, light playful bumps

bump.prompt: a soft bump into a cushion of moss
